lessons.title: From Blink to Drum Machine
lessons.summary: Build an oscillator that blinks an LED, then grow it step by step into a drum machine.

planned.title: Day 2 material
planned.summary: One slow oscillator, two slow oscillators, Blade Runner, Radio Amor, 4040 drummer, 4040 reset, voltage starving.

planned.title: Day 3 material
planned.summary: Slow and fast oscillators, the 4021 and LEDs, repetitive and generative 4021 drummers, microsound, glitch as musical structure.

planned.title: Day 4 material
planned.summary: Two slow oscillators, 4051 LEDs, a third oscillator, stepped low-pass clicks and tones, stepped band-pass tones.

planned.title: Day 5 material
planned.summary: Three oscillators, a diode network, an adjustable high-pass filter, voltage starving, static, strange things.
